CMD’s  MESSAGE
Firstly I would like to thank you for choosing our hotel.With this message I would like to  remind you as always,our priority is our guest’s satisfaction,our hotel is at your disposal. I would like to assure you as we have done so in the past, we will welcome you with a warm smile,offering safety, hospitality and all our services that managed to build a strong and warm relationship between our hotel and the guests for over 24 yrs.  I would like you to know,that we here at Hotel Poonja International always ensure you have an unforgettable experience.
Looking towards the future which is bright & promising, we at Hotel Poonja International, reiterate our commitment to serve our guests with utmost care & sincerity.
With warm regards,
Mr Prabhakar N Poonja
Chairman & Managing Director
About Us
Hotel Poonja International, located in the heart of downtown Mangalore, captures the essence of the city and more. Hotel Poonja International is one of the oldest hotels in Mangalore which is known for its time tested simple hospitality and homely ambience. At Hotel Poonja International, we strive to offer you an array of unique experiences -enthral with the definition of hospitality. Hotel Poonja International’s aim is to provide authentic hospitality.. We thrive to  make a difference in the lives of people we touch every day.
MISSION
To provide true and rich hospitality. We make a difference in the lives of those we touch every day – that is our definition of hospitality. We do this in an environment that respects all people and all ideas. We do it in an efficient way that leads to superior results.
IDEOLOGY
Hotel Poonja International is a place where the genuine care and comfort of our guests is our highest mission. We promise to provide the finest personal service and facilities for our guests with a warm, relaxed and superior ambience.
SLOGAN
Guest is the most important factor in our business He is not dependent on us, we are dependent on him He is not an interruption to our work, he is the purpose of it He is not an outsider to our business, he is part of it We are not doing a favor to him by serving him He is doing us a favor by giving us an opportunity to do so.
ACCOMODATION
The 154 luxurious guest rooms are comfortable and well-appointed, ideal for business travel as well as leisure. With facilities like an open air garden for large parties, banquets and receptions, restaurant, bar, a conference hall, your experience at Poonja will definitely be delightful to your senses. Be it the delectable meals at our restaurant Yuvaraj, the ambiance of our exquisite bar High Place or the fully equipped conference hall the Sabha and the Samrat,
At Hotel Poonja International, you can spend your days with great comfort and relaxation. So whether your travel is for pleasure or business, the Hotel invites you to get rejuvenated
Restaurants
YUVRAJ
At YUVRAJ our multi-cuisine restaurant you can choose from a wide range of cuisine continental or Chinese, Mughalai or Vegetarian. The picturesque interior creates a unique ambience that will delight you while you dine.
HIGH PLACE
The HIGH PLACE the bar houses a fine collection of exotic spirits. A cozy retreat at any time it has everything that just right to set you aglow. The hotels multi-cuisine restaurant offers the discerning diner a delectable choice from cuisine drawn from all over the world. The delightfully designed bar has
Banquet/Conferences Hall
SABHA
The SABHA our conference hall, comfortably house any gathering of up to 75. It is fully equipped with everything you will need for a successfully function. Fully flexible arrangements make it the perfect venue for whatever you have in mind. Conferences get-together, parties, conventions and receptions take off to a great start with Poonja international’s well equipped conference facilities.
SAMRAT
The SAMRAT, our banquet hall houses the gathering up to 600 Pax with all well equipped Banquet facilities
Location.
Hotel Poonja International is a perfect venue for whatever you have in mind. Situated only 20 minutes away from the Airport, 5 minutes from the Railway Station and only 10 minutes from the State Road Transport Bus Station, Hotel Poonja International if the first choice of the discerning traveller. The hotel is within ambling distance of major shopping, commercial and entertainment areas.
